Smatch detected a double free path because lpfc_nlp_not_used() releases an
ndlp object before reaching lpfc_nlp_put() at the end of
lpfc_cmpl_els_logo_acc().
Remove the outdated lpfc_nlp_not_used() routine.  In
lpfc_mbx_cmpl_ns_reg_login()
column2: replace the call with lpfc_nlp_put().  In

column1: lpfc_cmpl_els_logo_acc()
column2: replace the call with lpfc_unreg_rpi() and keep

column1: the lpfc_nlp_put() at the end of the routine.  If ndlp's rpi was
registered
column2: then lpfc_unreg_rpi()'s completion routine performs the final

column1: ndlp clean up after lpfc_nlp_put() is called from lpfc_cmpl_els_logo_acc().
Otherwise if ndlp has no rpi registered
column2: the lpfc_nlp_put() at the end of

column1: lpfc_cmpl_els_logo_acc() is the final ndlp clean up.
